Our seminar team recommends this month's web seminars.

【Title】
How to Tackle Customer Harassment: Building an Organization Free from Harassment

【Instructor】
Noriko Tsuda (津田典子)
Human Resources Development Consultant, Fine HR Representative

【Overview】
As obligations for customer harassment (カスハラ) prevention measures draw closer, companies must establish "guidelines to protect employees." By implementing appropriate measures, organizations create a safe and secure workplace for employees, which also leads to improved business performance.
This seminar covers the essential points that customer-facing businesses should understand and the benefits of implementation as a first step. (38 minutes)

【How to Access】
PC users: click the QR code. Smartphone users: scan the QR code.

※ Web seminar viewing is a member benefit of Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry. Member businesses seeking ID/password issuance should contact their assigned representative.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2635/
